_comment: Every player-visible UI string outside NPC dialogue (docs/GODOT.md §6). {vars} come from GameState.vars().
help: WASD move · Shift jog · Q/E or ←/→ orbit (or drag) · right-click / hold to walk there · Space talk · 1–9 choose · Esc close / visitor's card
help_debug: debug: F2 opening · F3 counter · F4 vault · F6 lobby · F7 manager · F8 name desk · F9 FX desk · F1 legend
prompt_elevator_main: [Space] Elevator — back to the Main wing
inpc_plate_awake: awake · reads your board, moves nothing
elevator_arc_deferred: ARC floor — coming soon. The Arc wing is under construction; the Main wing keeps serving.
escort_arrived: Here we are. Bob has your wire.
desk_link_lost: Lost the branch for a moment — reconnecting…
desk_link_back: Back in touch with the branch. Board re-read from the vault.
priority_copy: Skip the cooling period — hand scan required.
name_claim_hint: Your bank name is kept on Sepolia and points to your account. Counter can pay by it once Petra registers it.
name_claim_checking: Checking Petra's name register on Sepolia…
name_claim_bad_label: Choose one label only — Petra adds .branchzero.eth.
load_account_hint: An account of yours on the {wing} wing ({chain}). The desk terminal lists your account numbers; Iris checks the ledger says you hold it before loading it.
load_account_bad_address: That is not an account number — 0x followed by 40 characters.
load_account_hint_mock: MockChain — nothing here is on a chain. Two canned numbers answer: 0xC10ded…0001 is an earlier account of yours, 0xFACade…0002 belongs to somebody else.
passbook_anon: No account yet — see Iris at Account Opening.
passbook_pending: Wires in the vault · {pending} · next release {release_in}
passbook_no_account: Account not opened yet — Iris will open one.
passbook_delegated: Tellers stamp your slips on your instruction
passbook_mock: MockChain — nothing on this screen is on a chain
board_no_account: no account at this branch yet
fx_board_dark: Board dark — the branch can't reach the exchange floor.
fx_board_ask: Ask Johnny for a euro or shekel price.
fx_board_no_till: no till on the exchange floor yet
fx_board_closed: exchange door not on your approved list
fx_board_whitelist: approved services: prepare currency · authorise exchange · place trade — USD ↔ EUR | ILS both ways · counter pays {fx_payable}
names_board_invite: Petra can put yours on the board.
slip_hint: Up to {limit} {symbol} is handled at the counter. More goes through the vault ({timelock} cooling).
slip_bad_address: That is not an address the counter can pay (0x + 40 hex).
slip_bad_name: Write a full customer name, like florist.branchzero.eth.
slip_bad_amount: Write the amount as a number, e.g. 12.5
menu_tagline: A bank you can walk through.
menu_controls_esc: Esc closes a conversation or a slip first; on the open floor it opens your visitor's card.
menu_about_text: A small bank built for a hackathon, one building and eight members of staff. Every desk does a real thing on a public test network: the clerk opens your account, the teller stamps slips, the vault keeps its own clock, the registrar hands out names. The people who helped are on the partners board in the lobby.
menu_star_popup: Opened GitHub in a new tab — tap Star there, then come back to the bank.
menu_star_failed: GitHub would not take the star just now.
pause_sub: The branch stays open while you read this — nothing on the floor is put on hold.
pause_leave_ask: Leave the floor for today? Your account stays open — come back in through the front door whenever you like.
